setup.titolo: Set up Supabase to get started
setup.descrizione: BodyTrack can't find the credentials of your Supabase project. Complete these steps:

progetto.testo: Go to supabase.com, create a new project and wait for the database to be ready.

schema.testo: In the SQL Editor paste and run the contents of supabase/schema.sql (table, RLS and indexes).

chiavi.testo: From Project Settings → API copy the Project URL and anon public key and replace the placeholders.

riavvia.testo: Stop and restart `pnpm dev`: environment variables are read on startup.
